data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 and SRC_009 share mechanism for computing $855: both decompose pay into 40 regular hours at $18/hour ($720) plus 7 overtime hours at 1.5×$18=$27/hour ($189), totaling $855. SRC_005 states it as a standalone claim while SRC_009 uses it to refute premium-only overcounting. This shared mechanism is compatible with SRC_006's verification attempt. It is refuted if the overtime rate is not 1.5× the base rate or if overtime does not apply exclusively to hours beyond 40.
